target.title: fix(ui): show ClawHub security verdicts on first Skills load
target.body:
Fixes #108647

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users opening Control UI > Skills could see a clean, linked ClawHub skill labeled **Unavailable** on first load. The skill still worked, but the misleading security badge made a healthy installation look unverified.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Skills page now runs the existing verdict-only loader when it applies a route-provided status report. This hydrates security verdicts without repeating the `skills.status` request and keeps the existing agent-scope and reconnect guards intact. While the verdict request is in flight, a missing verdict is shown as **Refreshing** rather than **Unavailable**; genuine fetch errors and post-fetch missing verdicts still fail closed as **Unavailable**.

## User Impact

Linked ClawHub skills now show their real security status, such as **Clean**, on the first visit to the Skills page. There are no config, Gateway protocol, or migration changes.

## Evidence

- Real Chromium regression: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts src/pages/skills/skills-page.browser.test.ts` (1 test passed).
- Skills view coverage: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/pages/skills/view.test.ts` (10 tests passed).
- Shared Skills loader coverage: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/lib/skills/index.test.ts` (37 tests passed).
- Full `pnpm build` passed from this PR commit.
- Repository changed-file gate passed against `upstream/main`, including formatting, Control UI i18n verification, UI/core-test typechecks, lint, and repository guards.
- Final autoreview: no accepted/actionable findings; patch assessed correct with 0.88 confidence.

## Live Gateway Proof

Tested from commit `5ae87dad5faa04f8c391fc9768f707cd14941c10` with a freshly built Gateway, isolated temporary `OPENCLAW_HOME`, loopback-only auth, and a real ClawHub install of `@monikazapisekstudio/socratic-dialog@0.1.3`. Tokens and local paths are redacted below.

The installed skill was eligible and linked to valid ClawHub metadata:

```json
{
  "name": "socratic-dialogue",
  "eligible": true,
  "clawhub": {
    "status": "linked",
    "valid": true,
    "registry": "https://clawhub.ai",
    "slug": "socratic-dialog",
    "ownerHandle": "monikazapisekstudio",
    "installedVersion": "0.1.3"
  }
}
```

The live Gateway returned the clean verdict through the same RPC used by Control UI:

```console
$ openclaw gateway call skills.securityVerdicts --url ws://127.0.0.1:18889 --token '<redacted>' --timeout 30000 --json
{
  "schema": "openclaw.skills.security-verdicts.v1",
  "items": [{
    "ok": true,
    "decision": "pass",
    "requestedSlug": "socratic-dialog",
    "requestedVersion": "0.1.3",
    "securityStatus": "clean",
    "securityPassed": true
  }]
}
```

A new headless Chromium context then navigated directly to `/skills#token=<redacted>` against that Gateway. The capture asserted the first-load UI and recorded outgoing WebSocket methods:

```text
Fresh browser context: yes
Visible skill: socratic-dialogue
Visible security badge: Clean
Unavailable security badge present: false
skills.status requests: 1
skills.securityVerdicts requests: 1
Relevant RPC order: skills.status -> skills.securityVerdicts
```

This verifies the real route-data path hydrates the verdict once, does not duplicate `skills.status`, and renders **Clean** on the initial page load.

## AI Assistance

AI-assisted. I reviewed the data flow, understand the change, and validated the final diff and browser behavior before opening this PR.
